thread:
Sam (CS): Morning — CobaltBridge Day0 checklist. Known open items: egress allowlist, runtime SA + storage perms for model pulls, KMS ACL and rotation cadence, and Splunk audit ingestion with integrity header. @Inez can you lead firewall + SA networking? :wave:
Inez (NetOps): Yep. Which SA name will Cobalt create and where are models stored?
Marta (Cobalt): We'll create `cobalt-runtime-sa` in project `cobalt-prod`. Models are in GCS `gs://cobalt-models-prod` and some artifacts in a private S3 mirror.
Inez (NetOps): Will plan to grant `roles/storage.objectViewer` for GCS and configure cross-cloud access for S3 mirror. Egress ranges we need whitelisted for Redwood runtime: `35.196.0.0/14` and `34.120.0.0/14`. Ports: 443 and 10255 (health/metrics). Any additional ports?
Jo (Security): KMS rotation per contract is semi-annual for this account (different from standard). Key resource: `projects/cobalt-prod/locations/global/keyRings/cb-kr/cryptoKeys/cb-key-2`. Policy must bind `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` to Redwood runtime SA and `roles/cloudkms.viewer` to `group:cobalt-security@cobalt.example.com`. Also retention for audit logs: 400 days. We require integrity header `X-Signature` using HMAC-SHA256.
Ravi (SRE): For Splunk ingestion we enforce mTLS + TLS1.2+. Endpoint URL? Also send one sample event payload so we can validate parsing. We'll check schema mapping.
Marta (Cobalt): Splunk endpoint: `https://ingest.splunk.cobalt.example/services/collector`. We can provide client certs and a sample JSON event. Sample event: ```json
{"ts":"2026-04-02T09:15:00Z","svc":"cobalt-agent","evt":{"type":"model.pull","model":"cb-13b","status":"fetched","size":143210}}
```
cicd-bot: Runbook created: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/cobalt-week0 — includes onboarding checklist, KMS rotation doc, and where to drop certs.
Jo (Security): Note: please do not paste secrets in the thread. Upload certs/CSR and HMAC secret to the secure handoff doc only. I'll publish a minimal KMS policy snippet to the runbook.
Inez (NetOps): Action items recap: 1) Marta create SA and upload CSR/certs + sample event to runbook; 2) I will apply firewall egress and storage IAM after SA exists; 3) Jo to post KMS policy snippet and sign off on retention/cadence; 4) Ravi to validate Splunk ingestion and HMAC mapping. Target: EOD next business day. Any blockers? :thumbsup:
Marta (Cobalt): :thumbsup: We aim to provision by EOD PST and will DM the CSR to the secure handoff doc.
Sam (CS): Thanks everyone — I will update the runbook owners/ETAs and follow up in the morning.
